newsitem.title: USA: Canadian natgas prices rise in Alberta on storage.
newsitem.headline: Canadian natgas prices rise in Alberta on storage.

text.p: Canadian natural gas prices were marginally higher in Alberta but softer at the export points Friday, influenced mostly by storage, market sources said.
At the AECO storage hub, prices gained another two cents to about C$1.84-1.85 per gigajoule (GJ) as buyers stepped up their purchases to replenish the depleted western storage inventories.
Canadian Gas Association said gas stocks in the West as of April 11 were at 45.25 bcf, or about 17.46 percent full, compared with 29.5 percent a year ago.
